authorization: Shekhar explicitly assigned Codex the task of scoring these206 blinded answers. The existing guide assumed human scoring; this batch is separately labelled AI evaluation.

correctness.1: All material requested results/components correct. Minor locator or method/property terminology errors may be noted without reducing a substantively complete answer.
correctness.0.5: Substantive requested components correct, but material results/components omitted or wrong; materially false extra examples also count. Hedging does not erase supplied correct components.
correctness.0: Wrong target/behavior, or abstention with no substantive requested component beyond input restatement or generic possibilities.

citation_support.1: Actual cited ranges support material factual claims made; incompleteness is graded independently.
citation_support.0.5: Some claims supported but a material cited-source range, attribution, behavior or provenance claim is missing or contradicted.
citation_support.0: Citations do not support material factual claims.

abstention_policy: Keep abstentions and wrong attempted answers separate. A substantive correct partial answer stays partial even if the answer says evidence is insufficient.
source_policy: Inspect pinned actual source and the exact cited ranges, not only reference answers or evidence IDs. Citation correctness is independent of answer completeness.
duplicate_policy: Only identical question,reference,gold evidence,repo commit,generated answer,citations and citation claims share an assessment. Every item retains its distinct frozen score binding.
blinding: No condition labels, selected strategies or aggregate results exposed during scoring. Answer styles can still reveal a strategy.
review_time_policy: Original creation time (filesystem birthtime) of each completed assessment file, using the user-approved file-creation-time convention. ISO8601 America/New_York, microsecond precision exposed by filesystem API.
